Types of profiles available:
CountProfile

760mutex

29threadcreate

full goroutine stack dump

Profile Descriptions:

  • allocs:
    A sampling of all past memory allocations
  • block:
    Stack traces that led to blocking on synchronization primitives
  • cmdline:
    The command line invocation of the current program
  • goroutine:
    Stack traces of all current goroutines. Use debug=2 as a query parameter to export in the same format as an unrecovered panic.
  • heap:
    A sampling of memory allocations of live objects. You can specify the gc GET parameter to run GC before taking the heap sample.
  • mutex:
    Stack traces of holders of contended mutexes
  • profile:
    CPU profile. You can specify the duration in the seconds GET parameter. After you get the profile file, use the go tool pprof command to investigate the profile.
  • threadcreate:
    Stack traces that led to the creation of new OS threads
  • trace:
    A trace of execution of the current program. You can specify the duration in the seconds GET parameter. After you get the trace file, use the go tool trace command to investigate the trace.

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
@echo off

set server_ip=%1
set server_user=%2
set server_pwd=%3
set install_path=%4
set cusaplatform_user_dir=%5
set upload_folder=%6
set cusaplatform_root_path=%~d0
set cusaagent_folder=CusaDeployAgent
set start_bat_path=%install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%\service\start.bat

echo "cusaplatform_root_path is: " %cusaplatform_root_path%
echo "cusaplatform_user_dir is: " %cusaplatform_user_dir%
echo "start_bat_path is: " %start_bat_path%

cd /d %~dp0
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform	hirdparty
set local_folder=%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\%upload_folder%
:: set remote_folder= .170.90.218\D$\CusaDeployAgent
set remote_folder=\%server_ip%\%install_path%$\%cusaagent_folder%
echo "local_folder path: " %local_folder%
echo "remote_folder path: " %remote_folder%
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform\log
set log_file_path=%cusaplatform_user_dir%\log
echo %cd%
echo "-----set args finished!-----"

:: if exist %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log del %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log /f /s /q /a
if exist %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log del /F /S /Q %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log

if not exist %local_folder% (
    echo "error: %local_folder% not exist"
    echo "%local_folder% not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ /delete
ping %server_ip% -n 10 >nul
net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user%
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail"
    echo "error: net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail: ">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user%>>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log 2>&1
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----connect successed!-----"

if exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "%remote_folder% is exist, delete %remote_folder%"
    rd /S /Q %remote_folder%
    ping %server_ip% -n 10 >nul
)

xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I is fail"
    echo "xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
if not exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "error: %remote_folder% is not exist"
    echo "%remote_folder% is not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
echo "-----xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% finished!-----"


if exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip% (
    rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
) else (
    md %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
)
CALL %local_folder%\service\create-cusaagentxml.bat %server_ip% %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%
if not exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml (
    echo "error: create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail"
    echo "create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

if exist %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml del /S /Q %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml /f /s /q /a

copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y is fail"
    echo "copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%

net use \%server_ip% /delete
echo "-----delete connect successed!-----"

@echo "-----install cusaagent successed!
exit /b 0

:ERROREXIT
exit /b 1

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

# Version 2 license, then the option applies only if the new code is

# Contributor(s):

#
# resolve symlinks
#

PRG=$0

while [ -h "$PRG" ]; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '^.*-> \(.*\)$' 2>/dev/null`
    if expr "$link" : '^/' 2> /dev/null >/dev/null; then
	PRG="$link"
    else
	PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
    fi
done

progdir=`dirname "$PRG"`
APPNAME=`basename "$PRG"`

if [ -f "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

# XXX does not correctly deal with spaces in non-userdir params
args=""

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        userdir="${default_mac_userdir}"
        ;;
    *)
        userdir="${default_userdir}"
        ;;
esac
while [ $# -gt 0 ] ; do
    case "$1" in
        --userdir) shift; if [ $# -gt 0 ] ; then userdir="$1"; fi
            ;;
        *) args="$args "$1""
            ;;
    esac
    shift
done

if [ -f "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

if [ -n "$jdkhome" -a \! -d "$jdkhome" -a -d "$progdir/../$jdkhome" ]; then
    # #74333: permit jdkhome to be defined as relative to app dir
    jdkhome="$progdir/../$jdkhome"
fi

readClusters() {
  if [ -x /usr/ucb/echo ]; then
    echo=/usr/ucb/echo
  else
    echo=echo
  fi
  while read X; do
    if [ "$X" \!= "" ]; then
      $echo "$progdir/../$X"
    fi
  done
}

absolutize_paths() {
    while read path; do
        if [ -d "$path" ]; then
            (cd "$path" 2>/dev/null && pwd)
        else
            echo "$path"
        fi
    done
}

clusters=`(cat "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".clusters; echo) | readClusters | absolutize_paths | tr '
' ':'`

if [ ! -z "$extra_clusters" ] ; then
    clusters="$clusters:$extra_clusters"
fi

nbexec=`echo "$progdir"/../platform*/lib/nbexec`

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        eval exec sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            -J-Xdock:name='"$APPNAME"' \n            '"-J-Xdock:icon=$progdir/../../$APPNAME.icns"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
        ;;
    *)  
       sh=sh
       # #73162: Ubuntu uses the ancient Bourne shell, which does not implement trap well.
       if [ -x /bin/bash ]
       then
           sh=/bin/bash
       fi
       eval exec $sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
       exit 1
        ;;
esac

#!/bin/bash -x

# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT
# WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the
# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.127.6.15/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.127.6.15/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.127.6.15:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

echo "                    开始依赖检测与服务检测                    "

echo "-------------------------------------------------------------"

echo -n " 1/7:Ukey-https插件安装检测"
if ps -A | grep -wq 'pluginsource_ht'; then
  echo "    通过:Ukey-https插件正常运行"
else
  echo "  不通过:Ukey-https插件未正常运行"
fi 


echo -n " 2/7:Ukey-http插件安装检测 "
if ps -A | grep -wq 'pluginsource'; then
  echo "    通过:Ukey-http插件正常运行"
else
  echo "  不通过:Ukey-http插件未正常运行"
fi 


echo -n " 3/7:双因子服务端启动检测   "
if ss -tnl | awk '{print $4}' | grep -q ':8086'; then
  echo "   通过:双因子服务端正常运行"
else
  echo " 不通过:双因子服务端未正常运行"
fi


echo -n " 4/7:tmp目录权限检测       "
auth=`ls -ld /tmp | awk '{ print $1 }' |  cut -c 2-4`
if [ "$auth" = "rwx" ]; then
  echo "    通过:/tmp目录权限正常"
else
  echo "  不通过:tmp目录权限不正常"
fi


echo -n " 5/7:libMNN.so依赖检测     "
mnn=$(find /tmp -type f -name "libMNN.so" -print | head -n 1 )
if [ -z "$mnn" ]; then 
echo "  不通过:libMNN.so文件未成功创建"; 
fi
ldd  $mnn > /dev/null 2>&1
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "    通过:libMNN.so文件依赖正常"
else
  echo "  不通过:libMNN.so文件不正确"
fi


echo -n " 6/7:libdfacejni.so依赖检测"
dafcejni=$(find /tmp -type f -name "libdfacejni.so" -print | head -n 1 )
if [ -z "$dafcejni" ]; then 
echo "  不通过:libdfacejni.so文件未成功创建"; 
fi
ldd  $mnn > /dev/null 2>&1
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "    通过:libdfacejni.so文件依赖正常"
else
  echo "  不通过:libdfacejni.so文件不正确"
fi


echo -n " 7/7:人脸服务license激活检测"
A=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8086/face/checkAuthServer)
B=$(curl -s  http://localhost:8086/face/checkAuthServer)

if [ $A = 200 ];then
  if [[ "$B" == *"成功"* ]];then
    echo "   通过:人脸服务license已激活"
  else
    echo " 不通过:人脸服务license未激活"
  fi
else
  echo " 不通过:人脸服务未启动"
fi

# limitations under the License.

set -ex

# cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../.."
cd $2

# Install openssl (to use instead of boringssl)
# apt-get update && apt-get install -y libssl-dev
export INSTALL_DIR=$3/install
export OPENSSL_DIR=$6

# Use externally provided env to determine build parallelism, otherwise use default.
# GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS=${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS:-4}

# Install absl
rm -rf "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
cmake -E env CXXFLAGS="-std=c++11" cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install c-ares
rm -rf "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
cmake -E env CXXFLAGS="-std=c++11" cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install protobuf
rm -rf "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
cmake -E env CXXFLAGS="-std=c++11" cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF ..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install re2
rm -rf "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
cmake -E env CXXFLAGS="-std=c++11" cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install zlib

currentdir=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")"; pwd)

localip=`ip a|grep inet|grep -v 127.0.0.1|grep -v inet6|awk '{print $2}'|awk -F'/' '{print $1}'`
echo "服务器IP："$localip
port=`grep port config.json |grep "|awk -F':' '{print $2}'|grep "|awk -F'"' '{print $2}'`
echo "端口："$port

source /etc/profile
nohup node $currentdir/vendors/server/app.js >/dev/null 2>&1 &

yapinum=`ps -ef|grep vendors/server/app.js|grep -v grep|awk '{print $2}'|wc -l`
while [[ 1 != $yapinum ]]; do
	yapinum=`ps -ef|grep vendors/server/app.js|grep -v grep|awk '{print $2}'|wc -l`
	echo "等待yapi服务启动"
done
sleep 3
java -jar ../sliceTool/SliceTool.jar ice2yapi $localip:$port

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rsp_body:
@echo off

set server_ip=%1
set server_user=%2
set server_pwd=%3
set install_path=%4
set cusaplatform_user_dir=%5
set cusaplatform_root_path=%~d0
set cusaagent_folder=CusaDeployAgent
echo "cusaplatform_root_path is: " %cusaplatform_root_path%
echo "cusaplatform_user_dir is: " %cusaplatform_user_dir%

cd /d %~dp0
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform	hirdparty
set local_folder=%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\%cusaagent_folder%_win
:: set remote_folder=\10.170.90.218\D$\CusaDeployAgent
set remote_folder=\%server_ip%\%install_path%$\%cusaagent_folder%
echo "local_folder path: " %local_folder%
echo "remote_folder path: " %remote_folder%
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform\log
set log_file_path=%cusaplatform_user_dir%\log
echo %cd%
echo "-----set args finished!-----"

:: if exist %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log del %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log /f /s /q /a
if exist %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log del /F /S /Q %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log

if not exist %local_folder% (
    echo "error: %local_folder% not exist"
    echo "%local_folder% not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user%
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo " error: net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail"
    echo "net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----connect successed!-----"

if exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "%remote_folder% is exist, call stop.bat and delete %remote_folder%"
    %cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\WMIC.exe /node:%server_ip% /user:%server_user% /password:%server_pwd% process call create "cmd /c %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%\service\stop.bat"
    ping %server_ip% -n 30 >nul
    rd /S /Q %remote_folder%
)


xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% is fail"
    echo "xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
if not exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "error: %remote_folder% is not exist"
    echo "%remote_folder% is not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
echo "-----xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% finished!-----"


if exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip% (
    rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
) else (
    md %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
)
CALL %local_folder%\service\create-cusaagentxml.bat %server_ip% %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%
if not exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml (
    echo "error: create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail"
    echo "create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

if exist %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml del /S /Q %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml /f /s /q /a

copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml to \%server_ip%\%4$\CusaDeployAgent\service\ is fail"
    echo "%local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml to \%server_ip%\%4$\CusaDeployAgent\service\ is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ /delete
echo "-----delete connect successed!-----"

%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\WMIC.exe /node:%server_ip% /user:%server_user% /password:%server_pwd% process call create "cmd /c D:\CusaDeployAgent\service\start.bat"
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    set error_msg="call start.bat is fail"
    echo %error_msg%
    echo %error_msg%>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----install cusaagent successed!
exit /b 0

:ERROREXIT
exit /b 1

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

#
# resolve symlinks
#

PRG=$0

while [ -h "$PRG" ]; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '^.*-> \(.*\)$' 2>/dev/null`
    if expr "$link" : '^/' 2> /dev/null >/dev/null; then
	PRG="$link"
    else
	PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
    fi
done

progdir=`dirname "$PRG"`
APPNAME=`basename "$PRG"`
cd "$progdir/../"

if [ -f "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

# XXX does not correctly deal with spaces in non-userdir params
args=""

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        userdir="${default_mac_userdir}"
        ;;
    *)
        userdir="${default_userdir}"
        ;;
esac
while [ $# -gt 0 ] ; do
    case "$1" in
        --userdir) shift; if [ $# -gt 0 ] ; then userdir="$1"; fi
            ;;
        *) args="$args "$1""
            ;;
    esac
    shift
done

if [ -f "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

if [ -n "$jdkhome" -a \! -d "$jdkhome" -a -d "$progdir/../$jdkhome" ]; then
    # #74333: permit jdkhome to be defined as relative to app dir
    jdkhome="$progdir/../$jdkhome"
fi

readClusters() {
  if [ -x /usr/ucb/echo ]; then
    echo=/usr/ucb/echo
  else
    echo=echo
  fi
  while read X; do
    if [ "$X" \!= "" ]; then
      $echo "$progdir/../$X"
    fi
  done
}

absolutize_paths() {
    while read path; do
        if [ -d "$path" ]; then
            (cd "$path" 2>/dev/null && pwd)
        else
            echo "$path"
        fi
    done
}

clusters=`(cat "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".clusters; echo) | readClusters | absolutize_paths | tr '
' ':'`

if [ ! -z "$extra_clusters" ] ; then
    clusters="$clusters:$extra_clusters"
fi

nbexec=`echo "$progdir"/../platform*/lib/nbexec`

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        eval exec sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            -J-Xdock:name='"$APPNAME"' \n            '"-J-Xdock:icon=$progdir/../../$APPNAME.icns"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
        ;;
    *)  
       sh=sh
       # #73162: Ubuntu uses the ancient Bourne shell, which does not implement trap well.
       if [ -x /bin/bash ]
       then
           sh=/bin/bash
       fi
       eval exec $sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
       exit 1
        ;;
esac

export MINIO_ACCESS_USER=admin

getpid(){
	pid=`ps -ef | grep minio | grep server| awk '{print $2}'`;
	if [ -n "$pid" ];
	then 
		return 1
	else
		return 0
	fi
}

getpid

then

record.rsp_body:
@echo off

::先停止服务
taskkill /f /im nginx.exe
taskkill /f /im javaw.exe

cd /d %~dp0
cd ..
set WEB_HOME=%cd%

set SERVICE_HOME=%WEB_HOME%\service\cable-health-monitor

::启动nginx
set NGINX_HOME=%WEB_HOME%	hirdparty
ginx
cd %NGINX_HOME%
start nginx.exe

set JAVA_HOME=%WEB_HOME%	hirdparty\java
::设置jvm参数
set DEBUG_ARG=-Xdebug -Xnoagent -Djava.compiler=NONE -Xrunjdwp:transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=n,address=5005
set JMX_ARG=-Djava.rmi.server.hostname=localhost -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=8087 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.rmi.port=8087 -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false -Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false  -Xmx2g -Xms2g -Xmn1g
set DUMP_ARG=-XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError -XX:HeapDumpPath=%SERVICE_HOME%icloud_%t.hprof

start %JAVA_HOME% in\javaw %DEBUG_ARG% %JMX_ARG% %DUMP_ARG% -jar -Dspring.profiles.active=prod %SERVICE_HOME%\cable-health-monitor-starter.jar &
exit

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -x

# Copyright 2013 OpenStack Foundation
#

# not use this file except in compliance with the License. You may obtain
# a copy of the License at
#
#      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT
# WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the
# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=()

openEuler_RPM_spec=()

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

###Clean up rpmbuild/
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
##exit
##eeooff
##
###Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
##cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
##    do
##        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
##        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
##    done
##
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
##    do
##        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
##    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

###build openEuler RPMs
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##set -o errexit
##cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##rpmbuild -ba *
##set +o errexit
##exit
##eeooff
##if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
##    exit 1
##fi
##
### Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
##if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
##  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
##fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  sleep 5
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
fi

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=('python3_oslo_config' \n'python-cipherclient' \n'python-licenseclient' \n'python-monitorclient' \n'python-serviceclient' \n'update' \n'python3_oslo_messaging')

openEuler_RPM_spec=('recipes-base/python-oslo-config/euler/python3-oslo-config.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-cipherclient/euler/cipherclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/licenseclient/euler/licenseclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-monitorclient/euler/monitorclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/serviceclient/euler/serviceclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/cgcs-patch/euler/cgcs-patch.spec' \n'recipes-base/python-oslo-messaging/euler/python3-oslo-messaging.spec')

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7:60022/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7:60022/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#Clean up rpmbuild/
ssh fh@10.150.2.132 << eeooff
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
exit
eeooff

#Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.150.2.132
cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
    do
        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.150.2.132:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
    done

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.150.2.132:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

#build openEuler RPMs
ssh fh@10.150.2.132 << eeooff
set -o errexit
cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
rpmbuild -ba *
set +o errexit
exit
eeooff
if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
    exit 1
fi

# Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
fi

ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
scp -P60022 ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
ssh fh@10.150.2.132 "scp -P60022 /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"

@echo off
Setlocal Enabledelayedexpansion

set localPath=%~dp0
call %localPath%\getpathdir.bat

if "%1"=="NOPAUSE" goto INSTALL

set /p CONFIRM=Are you sure to create all database? Click y to continue.
if not "%CONFIRM%"=="y" goto :EOF

set Str=0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ
set /a len=6
for /l %%i in (1,1,8888) do (if "!Str:~0,%%i!"=="!Str!" set StrSum=%%i&goto :result)
:result
set /a Num+=1,StrNum=%Random%%%%StrSum%
set result=%result%!str:~%StrNum%,1!
if %Num% lss %len% goto :result
echo %result%
set /p CONFIRM_AGAIN=Please enter same random string to comfirm createdatabase:
if not "%CONFIRM_AGAIN%"=="%result%" goto :EOF

:INSTALL

call "%~dp0log_for_kill_process.bat" caller "%~0"

call %u2KInstalPath%\server	ool\createdatabase.bat NOPAUSE

echo "Finished!"
if not "%1"=="NOPAUSE" pause

@echo off
echo "-----start build-2.bat-----"
:: param1-----node zip name
:: ---------------------------prepare node path--------------------------------------
set node_path=D:\%1\necho "node_path:"%node_path%
::set path=%node_path%;C:\Program Files\WinRAR;%path%
echo "path:"%path%
set origin_folder=%~dp0
echo %origin_folder%
cd ..
set parent_folder=%cd%
set tool_folder=%parent_folder%\dev_tools
echo tool_folder%tool_folder%
cd %origin_folder%
set SASS_BINARY_PATH=%tool_folder%\win32-x64-64_binding.node
:: ---------------------------prepare build path--------------------------------------
set dist_folder=D:/dist
echo "dist folder:" %dist_folder%
set current_folder=%~dp0
echo "current folder:" %current_folder%

:: check environments
echo "-----check node version-----"
call node -v

echo "-----check npm version-----"
call npm -v

echo "-----check npm config list-----"
call npm config list

echo "-----check ng version-----"
call ng version


:: ---------------------------waf cli-----------------------------------
::call npm install -g @waf_cli/cli
::    if %errorlevel%==0 (
::        @echo "-----global install waf cli succeed! current version:-----"
::        call waf -V
::    ) else (
::        @echo "-----global install waf cli failed! -----"
::        goto end
::    )

:: ---------------------------waf build---------------------------------
call waf init %current_folder%/..
call waf build -w %current_folder%
    if %errorlevel%==0 (
        @echo "-----waf build succeed! dist directory: -----"
        @echo %dist_folder%
    ) else (
        @echo "-----waf build failed!-----"
        goto end
    )

:end
echo "-----end build-2.bat-----"

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
date
basepath=$(cd `dirname $0` ; pwd )
tmppath="$basepath/../tmp/cmake/pas"
makedir -p temppath
echo "basepath=$basepath"
echo "temp pas dir is $tmppath"
set UNM_NO_PAUSE=1

IB_CONSOLE=`which ib_console`
echo "IB_CONSOLE=$IB_CONSOLE"

echo ${UNM_BUILD_CNT:=8}
echo "UNM_BUILD_CNT is $UNM_BUILD_CNT"

built_type=Debug
echo "built_type=$built_type"
cd $basepath
bash $basepath/cmake_create_all_unm_makes_with_binary_platform.sh $built_type
ret=$?
if [ $ret -ne 0 ];then
    echo "cmake failed! exit = $ret"
    date
    exit $ret
fi

cd $tmppath 
if [ -n "$UNM_BUILD_WITH_IB" -a -n "$IB_CONSOLE" ]; then
	echo "ib_console -d1 make -j 160"
	ib_console -d1 make -j 160
else
	echo "make -j $UNM_BUILD_CNT"
	make -j $UNM_BUILD_CNT
fi

ret=$?
if [ $ret -ne 0 ];then
    echo "build failed! exit = $ret"
    date
    exit $ret
fi

if [ -d ../../../UNM2000/pas/bin ]; then
	rm -rfv ../../../UNM2000/pas/bin
fi

mkdir -p ../../../UNM2000/pas/bin
chmod 777 ../../../UNM2000/pas/bin
cp ./lib/*.* ../../../UNM2000/pas/bin
cp ./bin/* ../../../UNM2000/pas/bin



#if [ -z "$UNM_BUILD_CNT" ]; then
#        echo "UNM_BUILD_CNT is empty, default is 4"
#        make -j 4
#else
#        echo "UNM_BUILD_CNT is $UNM_BUILD_CNT"
#        make -j $UNM_BUILD_CNT
#fi
#make -j 16 
date

export INSTALL_DIR=$3/install
export OPENSSL_DIR=$6

# 1.46.5 version cannot be compiled by gcc-4.8. by lizhuo
export CC=$2/gcc-4.9.4/bin/gcc
export CXX=$2/gcc-4.9.4/bin/g++
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fPIC -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections"
export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$2/gcc-4.9.4/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

# Use externally provided env to determine build parallelism, otherwise use default.
# GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS=${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS:-4}

# Install absl
rm -rf "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install c-ares
rm -rf "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCARES_STATIC=ON -DCARES_SHARED=OFF ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install protobuf
rm -rf "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF ..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install re2
rm -rf "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install zlib
rm -rf "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Just before installing gRPC, wipe out contents of all the submodules to simulate
# a standalone build from an archive
# shellcheck disable=SC2016
# git submodule foreach 'cd $toplevel; rm -rf $name'

# Install gRPC
rm -rf "cmake/build"
mkdir -p "cmake/build"
pushd "cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" \n  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 \n  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR \n  -DOPENSSL_ROOT_DIR=$OPENSSL_DIR \n  -DZLIB_ROOT=%INSTALL_DIR% \n  -DgRPC_INSTALL=ON \n  -DgRPC_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \n  -DgRPC_ABSL_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_CARES_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_PROTOBUF_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_RE2_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_SSL_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_ZLIB_PROVIDER=package \n  ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd
